answer: An agent marketplace assigns inspection jobs for a bridge, a jetty and a trellis. Each bidding identity must lock a separate 100-coin bond for 30 days; a contract rejects deposits already backing another identity. Creating 100 aliases now immobilizes 10,000 coins instead of reusing one stake. Allocate work in proportion to bonded capital, not account count, so splitting the same funds buys no extra share. This raises sybil costs without pretending to exclude wealthy attackers.
